Name: Eurasian Birds for Ornithologist's Guild
Author: Mazoout
Description:
[i]French version below!

[/i][size=3]A (quite big) bird pack for Ivy's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14510]Bird overhaul - Ornithologist's Guild[/url] mod adding 15 species of birds ! You'll see and hear them roaming around the valley for your enjoyment, as a stroller as well as a binocular-wearing birder![/size]

[b][size=4][size=4][b][b][size=4][b][color=#6aa84f]⨀[/color][color=#ffd966]>[/color][/b][/size][/b][/b][/size] CONTENT
[/size][/b]Fifteen (uwaaah) species of birds native to Eurasia - some overwintering in Africa so African too. Ferngill is based on the USA, but now you'll also be able to curse the annoying magpies, hear the male cuckoo's song and watch the lovely puffins on the coast.
Discover the species here and check the article for far more details in case you miss some.
[spoiler]
[list]
[*][url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eurasian_jay]Oak Jay[/url]﻿ - [i]Garrulus glandarius[/i]
[*][url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eurasian_blue_tit]Blue Tit[/url]﻿ - [i]Cyanistes caeruleus[/i]
[*][url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eurasian_bullfinch]Bullfinch[/url]﻿ - [i]Pyrrhula pyrrhula[/i]
[*][url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Red-crested_pochard]Red-crested Pochard[/url]﻿ - [i]Netta rufina[/i]
[*][url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/White_stork]White Stork[/url]﻿ - [i]Ciconia ciconia[/i]
[*][url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eurasian_magpie]Common Magpie[/url]﻿ - [i]Pica pica[/i]
[*][url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Common_cuckoo]Grey Cuckoo[/url]﻿ - [i]Cuculus canorus[/i]
[*][url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eurasian_golden_oriole]Golden Oriole[/url]﻿ - [i]Oriolus oriolus[/i]
[*][url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Common_kingfisher]River Kingfisher[/url]﻿ - [i]Alcedo atthis[/i]
[*][url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eurasian_hobby]Squire Hobby[/url]﻿ - [i]Falco subbuteo[/i]
[*][url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Greater_flamingo]Greater Flamingo[/url]﻿ - [i]Phoenicopterus roseus[/i]
[*][url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Atlantic_puffin]Gem Sea Puffin[/url]﻿ - [i]Fratercula arctica[/i]
[*][url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tawny_owl]Tawny Owl[/url]﻿ - [i]Strix aluco[/i]
[*][url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sandwich_tern]Northern Stern[/url]﻿ - [i]Thalasseus sandvicensis[/i]
[*][url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Common_kingfisher]Green Woodpecker[/url]﻿ - [i]Picus viridis[/i]
[/list][/spoiler]
Feedback is very welcome!


[size=4][b][b][size=4][b][color=#6aa84f]⨀[/color][color=#ffd966]>[/color][/b][/size][/b] INSTALLATION[/b][/size]
Drop the unzipped file in your mod folder. That's it!
The mod is safe to add or remove mid-game.


[b][size=4][size=4][b][b][size=4][b][color=#6aa84f]⨀[/color][color=#ffd966]>[/color][/b][/size][/b][/b][/size] TRIVIA[/size][/b]
I used the info available on the website of the [url=https://www.lpo.fr/]Ligue de protection des oiseaux[/url] (LPO, Bird Protection League), the main French bird protection association. Their work is amazing.
I also thank the anonymous contributors to Wikipedia for making pages available in multiple languages and saving me lots of time to find names and bird vocabulary!

More birds ? Add Zebra finches, Canaries and Lovebirds with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22713]Arrbyte's Birds for Ornithologists Guild[/url] (with self-recorded sounds, isn't it amazing?) !


[b][size=4][size=4][b][b][size=4][b][color=#6aa84f]⨀[/color][color=#ffd966]>[/color][/b][/size][/b][/b][/size] ABOUT THE ENGLISH TRANSLATION[/size][/b]
Quite a few species included in this mod have a common name including "Eurasian". As a choice, I don't use names of real places in mods. Thus, I translated the French (my native language) qualifier, used a less-known one, invented it or straight deleted it. The scientific name have been kept as is, though, and the original name is mentioned in the i18n default.json.
Species: [spoiler]
[list]
[*]Oak Jay = Eurasian Jay (from French "geai des chênes")
[*]Blue Tit = Eurasian Blue Tit
[*]Bullfinch = Eurasian bullfinch
[*]Common Magpie = Eurasian magpie
[*]Grey Cuckoo = Common Cuckoo (from French "coucou gris")
[*]Golden Oriole = Eurasian Golden Oriole
[*]River Kingfisher = Common Kingfisher (less-known name)
[*]Squire Hobby = Eurasian Hobby (from French "faucon hobereau")
[*]Gem Sea Puffin = Atlantic Puffin (Stardew Valley's geography)
[*]Northern Stern = Sandwich Tern (adapted - "Sandwich" comes from the isles of the same name)
[*]Green Woodpecker = European Green Woodpecker
[/list][/spoiler]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26667]Translation in Mandarin[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/190627779]arcturusyu[/url]!
[b]Do you want to add a translation? You're welcome to! Just [u]ask me before[/u] to make sure nobody else is yet working on the same language. You're welcome to add your own mod page with your translation and this mod as dependancy.[/b]


[b][size=4][size=4][b][b][size=4][b][color=#6aa84f]⨀[/color][color=#ffd966]>[/color][/b][/size][/b][/b][/size] HUGE THANKS TO:[/size][/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/81086143]Ivy[/url], of course, for making the Bird Overhaul mod, and for making it so easy to add new birdies, even by newbies like yours truly. Thank you bird lover!
[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/riotgirl5989/about-me]Riot[/url], for beta-reading my French to English home-made translation and pointing the gendered nonsense that escaped my attention OwO <3


[b][size=4][size=4][b][b][size=4][b][color=#6aa84f]⨀[/color][color=#ffd966]>[/color][/b][/size][/b][/b][/size] DONATIONS?[/size][/b]
What I'll earn through donation points will go the [url=https://www.lpo.fr]LPO[/url]. You might prefer to donate to your local birder's association, and that's great!

[i]En français ![/i]
[center]﻿[/center][center][size=5][b][size=6][b][b][b][b][color=#6aa84f]⨀[/color][color=#ffd966]>[/color][/b][/b][/b] [/b][/size]Oiseaux d'Eurasie pour la Guilde des Ornithologues[size=6][b] [color=#ffd966]<[/color][color=#6aa84f]⨀[/color][/b][/size][/b][/size][/center]

[size=3]Découvrez 15 espèces d'oiseaux d'Eurasie (et d'Afrique en tant que migrateurs !) venus dans Stardew Valley ! Profitez de leurs chants et leurs couleurs durant vos promenades ou allez à leur rencontre pour remplir votre carnet d'ornithologue. Pack d'extension pour le mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14510]Bird overhaul - Ornithologist's Guild[/url]﻿ ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26089]traduit en français[/url]) d'Ivy.[/size]

[b][size=4][size=4][b][b][size=4][b][color=#6aa84f]⨀[/color][color=#ffd966]>[/color][/b][/size][/b][/b][/size] CONTENU
[/size][/b]Quinze (uwaaah) espèces d'oiseaux natives d'Eurasie (et certaines hivernant en Afrique du coup elles sont africaines aussi). La république de Ferngill est basée sur les États-Unis, mais c'est la magie du jeu vidéo !
Découvrez les espèces disponibles ci-après et obtenez plus de détails dans l'article disponible sur cette page.
[spoiler]
[list]
[*]Geai des chênes - [i]Garrulus glandarius[/i]
[*]Mésange bleue - [i]Cyanistes caeruleus[/i]
[*]Bouvreuil pivoine - [i]Pyrrhula pyrrhula[/i]
[*]Nette rousse - [i]Netta rufina[/i]
[*]Cigogne blanche - [i]Ciconia ciconia[/i]
[*]Pie bavarde - [i]Pica pica[/i]
[*]Coucou gris - [i]Cuculus canorus[/i]
[*]Loriot doré (d'Europe) - [i]Oriolus oriolus[/i]
[*]Martin-pêcheur - [i]Alcedo atthis[/i]
[*]Faucon hobereau[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eurasian_hobby][/url]﻿ - [i]Falco subbuteo[/i]
[*]Flamant rose - [i]Phoenicopterus roseus[/i]
[*]Macareux moine - [i]Fratercula arctica[/i]
[*]Chouette hulotte - [i]Strix aluco[/i]
[*]Sterne caugek - [i]Thalasseus sandvicensis[/i]
[*]Pic vert[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Common_kingfisher][/url]﻿ - [i]Picus viridis[/i]
[/list][/spoiler]

[size=4][b][b][size=4][b][color=#6aa84f]⨀[/color][color=#ffd966]>[/color][/b][/size][/b] INSTALLATION[/b][/size]
Dézippez le dossier et glissez le dans votre dossier Mods. C'est tout !
Vous pouvez ajouter ou supprimer ce mod à tout moment sans problème.


[b][size=4][size=4][b][b][size=4][b][color=#6aa84f]⨀[/color][color=#ffd966]>[/color][/b][/size][/b][/b][/size] INFOS[/size][/b]
J'ai utilisé les informations disponibles sur le site de la [url=https://www.lpo.fr/]Ligue de protection des oiseaux[/url]﻿ (LPO), l'association française la plus connue. Ils font un travail fantastique !
Un grand merci également aux contributeur·ices anonymes de Wikipédia qui ont écrit des pages en français et en anglais sur les espèces présentes, ce qui aide grandement à la traduction !


[b][size=4][size=4][b][b][size=4][b][color=#6aa84f]⨀[/color][color=#ffd966]>[/color][/b][/size][/b][/b][/size] UN GRAND MERCI À :[/size][/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/81086143]Ivy[/url]﻿ (ivylovesbirds), bien sûr, pour avoir créé le mod de la Guilde des ornithologues et fait en sorte qu'il soit si facile de rajouter ses propres oiseaux !
[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/riotgirl5989/about-me]Riot[/url]﻿, en tant que bêta-lectrice de la traduction anglaise (c'est compliqué de ne pas genrer les noms uwaaaah) <3

[b][size=4][size=4][b][b][size=4][b][color=#6aa84f]⨀[/color][color=#ffd966]>[/color][/b][/size][/b][/b][/size] DONS ?[/size][/b]
Ce que j'obtiens par les donation points ira à la [url=https://www.lpo.fr]LPO[/url]﻿ ! Vous pouvez donner ce que vous souhaitez à l'association de protection des oiseaux de votre choix.
